personality_one_liner: A vibrant, light, and modern event operations hub combining iOS-native clarity with frosted glassmorphism and semantic color coding.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native rhythm. Ensure intentional whitespace around cards and inside heavy forms.

do's: Use expo-blur for the bottom tab bar
Use expo-blur for sticky headers over scrolling lists
Use frosted glass over the hero image on the login screen
Add a glass container behind the sticky CTA inside the event detail form
dont's: Do not blur standard event cards in lists (use surfaceSecondary)
Do not use blur inside text inputs

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Authentication screen greeting the user with a premium brand feel.

states.error: Standard alert or inline red text

screens.layout: Hero background image covering the full screen. Add a top-to-bottom transparent to surfaceInverse gradient scrim (bottom 50% must be ≥70% opacity). Place the login form inside a glassmorphic card (expo-blur) pinned to the bottom third of the screen. Keep it clean and elegant.

screens.name: Kalendarz
screens.purpose: Primary view for checking daily events via a month grid.

states.empty: Empty state illustration below the calendar grid

screens.layout: White background. Keep the bell icon top-right. Render a clean iOS-style month grid. Status dots (colored by status) remain under day numbers. Selected day uses a brandPrimary solid pill. Below the calendar, display a FlashList of events for the selected day using surfaceSecondary cards.

screens.name: Imprezy (Ostatnie)
screens.purpose: List of recent/upcoming events with quick filtering.
screens.layout: Use a horizontally scrolling row of filter chips at the top (pill radius, surfaceTertiary, active state uses Category color). Below, a FlashList of event cards. Each card must have lg radius, lg padding, Tier 1 shadow. Display Category color as a subtle tag or left-border strip, and Status color as a pulsing dot. Use Space Grotesk for dates/times.

screens.name: Oferta
screens.layout: Single column form inside a large surfaceSecondary card. Use iOS-style segmented controls (with surfaceTertiary bg) to toggle between PDF/DOCX. Inputs have surfaceTertiary backgrounds. Sticky 'Wyślij' (Send) primary CTA button pinned at the bottom over a glassmorphic bar.

screens.name: Koszty
screens.layout: At the top, a large summary card showing total expenses in Space Grotesk (e.g., 32pt). Below it, a clean list of expense rows. Use an expo-blur Floating Action Button (FAB) positioned bottom-right to add new expenses.

screens.name: Pracownicy
screens.layout: 2-column grid of staff cards. Each card contains an initials avatar inside a brandTertiary circle, the staff name, and their hourly rate clearly displayed in Space Grotesk.

screens.name: Statystyki
screens.layout: Scrollable dashboard. Top sections contain colorful modern bar/line charts. Bottom section contains distinct integration cards (e.g., 'Google Calendar Sync', 'Eksport ICS') with relevant icons and subtle background gradients.

screens.name: Event Detail [id]
screens.purpose: Massive form for editing a specific event.
screens.layout: Wrap the 30+ fields in visually distinct collapsible sections or grouped surfaceSecondary cards (e.g., 'Dane klienta', 'Płatność', 'Personel'). Use labels above inputs. Sticky 'Zapisz' (Save) CTA at the absolute bottom wrapped in a glassmorphic container to ensure it's always accessible without scrolling to the end.

login_hero.alt: Table with vase of flowers in autumn forest

empty_calendar.alt: Minimalist modern empty desk with calendar

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'iOS-Native Clean' personality utilizing a vibrant, lighter palette to replace the old dark forest green theme.
CRITICAL: Keep the Polish language for all labels and copy.
CRITICAL: Keep the 6 bottom tabs structure. Ensure the tab bar uses expo-blur for a modern transparent feel.

CRITICAL: Ensure category colors (firmowe=blue, okolicznosciowe=gold, urodzinki=pink, warsztaty=green) and status colors (potwierdzona=green, wstepne/rezerwacja=yellow, anulowana=red) are strictly mapped as specified in the color tokens.
CRITICAL: Retain the FlashList implementation for the Imprezy (Ostatnie) screen to guarantee performance with 500+ items.
Utilize 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all general UI text and 'Space Grotesk' exclusively for dates, times, hourly rates, and metric numbers to inject a modern technical vibe.

Refactor the dense Event Detail screen (~30 fields) by grouping inputs into surfaceSecondary cards to prevent cognitive overload. Implement a sticky save button at the bottom over an expo-blur background.
Swap Feather icons for Ionicons. Use outlined variants for inactive states and filled variants for active states (especially in the tab bar).
